name: Nikon D850
description: Nikon D850，尼康FX全画幅F卡口数码单反相机。参数来自尼康官方规格及说明书，保留最高性能的适用条件。

rows.label: 类型
rows.value: 数码单反相机

rows.label: 镜头卡口
rows.value: 尼康F卡口 (with AF coupling and AF contacts)

rows.label: 等效视角
rows.value: 尼康FX格式

rows.label: 兼容镜头
rows.value: Compatible with AF NIKKOR lenses, including type G, E and D lenses (some restrictions apply to PC lenses), and DX lenses [using DX (24x16) image area], AI-P NIKKOR lenses, and non-CPU AI lenses (exposure modes A and M only); IX-NIKKOR lenses, lenses for the F3AF, and non-AI lenses cannot be used The electronic rangefinder can be used with lenses that have a maximum aperture of f/5.6 or faster (the electronic rangefinder supports 15 focus points with lenses that have a maximum aperture of f/8 or faster, of which 9 points are available for selection)

rows.label: 有效像素
rows.value: 45.7百万像素

rows.label: 图像传感器
rows.value: 35.9 x 23.9 mm CMOS传感器

rows.label: 总像素
rows.value: 46.89百万像素

rows.value: 影像传感器 cleaning, Image Dust Off reference data (Capture NX-D software required)
rows.originalValue: Image sensor cleaning, Image Dust Off reference data (Capture NX-D software required)

rows.label: 照片尺寸

rows.label: 文件格式
rows.value: NEF (RAW): 12 or 14 bit (lossless compressed, compressed or uncompressed); large, medium and small available (medium and small images are recorded at a bit depth of 12 bits using lossless compression) TIFF (RGB) JPEG: JPEG-Baseline compliant with fine (约 1 : 4), normal (约 1 : 8) or basic (约 1 : 16) compression; optimal quality compression available NEF (RAW)+JPEG: Single photograph recorded in both NEF (RAW) and JPEG formats

rows.label: 优化校准
rows.value: Auto, Standard, Neutral, Vivid, Monochrome, Portrait, Landscape, Flat; selected Picture Control can be modified; storage for custom Picture Controls

rows.label: 存储介质
rows.value: XQD and SD (Secure Digital) and UHS-II compliant SDHC and SDXC memory cards

rows.label: 双卡槽
rows.value: Either card can be used for primary or backup storage or for separate storage of NEF (RAW) and JPEG images; pictures can be copied between cards

rows.label: 文件系统
rows.value: DCF 2.0, Exif 2.31, PictBridge

rows.label: 测光系统
rows.value: TTL exposure metering using main image sensor

rows.label: 测光模式
rows.value: Matrix, center-weighted or highlight-weighted

rows.label: 视频尺寸与帧率
rows.value: 3840 x 2160 (4K UHD); 30p (progressive), 25p, 24p 1920 x 1080; 60p, 50p, 30p, 25p, 24p 1280 x 720; 60p, 50p 1920 x 1080 (slow-mo); 30p x4, 25p x4, 24p x5 Actual frame rates for 60p, 50p, 30p, 25p and 24p are 59.94, 50, 29.97, 25 and 23.976 fps respectively; quality selection available at all sizes except 3840 x 2160 (when quality is fixed at ★) and 1920 x 1080 slow-mo (when quality is fixed at "normal")

rows.label: 视频文件格式
rows.value: MOV, MP4

rows.value: H.264/MPEG-4 Advanced Video Coding

rows.value: Built-in stereo or external microphone; sensitivity adjustable

rows.value: Exposure modes P, S and A: Auto ISO sensitivity control (ISO 64 to Hi 2) with selectable upper limit Exposure mode M: Auto ISO sensitivity control (ISO 64 to Hi 2) available with selectable upper limit; manual selection (ISO 64 to 25600 in steps of 1/3, 1/2 or 1 EV) with additional options available equivalent to 约 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1 or 2 EV (ISO 102400 equivalent) above ISO 25600

rows.label: 动态D-Lighting
rows.value: Can be selected from same as photo settings, extra high, high, normal, low or off

rows.value: 约 0.75x (50 mm f/1.4 lens at infinity, -1.0 m -1 )

rows.value: 17 mm (-1.0 m -1 ; from center surface of viewfinder eyepiece lens)

rows.value: Type B BriteView Clear Matte Mark VIII screen with AF area brackets (framing grid can be displayed)

rows.label: 反光镜
rows.value: Quick return

rows.value: Pressing Pv button stops lens aperture down to value selected by user (A and M modes) or by camera (P and S modes)

rows.label: 镜头光圈
rows.value: Instant return, electronically controlled

rows.label: 类型
rows.value: Electronically controlled vertical-travel focal-plane 机械快门; 电子前帘快门 available in quiet shutter-release, quiet continuous shutter-release and mirror up release modes
rows.originalValue: Electronically controlled vertical-travel focal-plane mechanical shutter; electronic front-curtain shutter available in quiet shutter-release, quiet continuous shutter-release and mirror up release modes

rows.label: 快门速度
rows.value: 1/8000 to 30 s in steps of 1/3, 1/2 or 1 EV, bulb, time, X250

rows.label: 闪光同步速度
rows.value: X=1/250 s; synchronizes with shutter at 1/250 s or slower; auto FP high-speed sync supported

rows.label: 释放模式
rows.value: S (single frame), CL (continuous low speed), CH (continuous high speed), Q (quiet shutter-release), QC (quiet continuous shutter-release), Self-timer, MUP (mirror up)

rows.label: 连拍速度
rows.value: With an EN-EL18b battery inserted in an MB-D18 battery pack CL: 1 to 8 fps, CH: 9 fps, QC: 3 fps Other power sources CL: 1 to 6 fps, CH: 7 fps, QC: 3 fps

rows.label: 自拍定时
rows.value: 2 s, 5 s, 10 s, 20 s; 1 to 9 exposures at intervals of 0.5, 1, 2 or 3 s

rows.label: 测光系统
rows.value: TTL exposure metering using RGB sensor with 约 180K (180,000) pixels

rows.label: 测光模式
rows.value: Matrix: 3D color matrix metering III (type G, E and D lenses); color matrix metering III (other CPU lenses); color matrix metering available with non-CPU lenses if user provides lens data Center-weighted: Weight of 75% given to 12 mm circle in center of frame; diameter of circle can be changed to 8, 15 or 20 mm, or weighting can be based on average of entire frame (non-CPU and AF-S Fisheye NIKKOR 8-15mm f/3.5-4.5E ED lenses use 12-mm circle) Spot: Meters 4 mm circle (about 1.5% of frame) centered on selected focus point (on center focus point when non-CPU or AF-S Fisheye NIKKOR 8-15mm f/3.5-4.5E ED lens is used) Highlight-weighted: Available with type G, E and D lenses

rows.label: 测光范围 (ISO 100, f/1.4 lens, 20°C/68°F)
rows.value: Matrix or center-weighted metering: -3 to 20 EV Spot metering: 2 to 20 EV Highlight-weighted metering: 0 to 20 EV

rows.label: 测光耦合
rows.value: Combined CPU and AI

rows.label: 模式
rows.value: Programmed auto with flexible program (P); shutter-priority auto (S); aperture-priority auto (A); manual (M)

rows.label: 曝光补偿
rows.value: -5 to +5 EV in increments of 1/3, 1/2 or 1 EV

rows.label: 曝光锁定
rows.value: Luminosity locked at detected value

rows.value: ISO 64 to 25600 in steps of 1/3, 1/2 or 1 EV; can also be set to 约 0.3, 0.5, 0.7 or 1 EV (ISO 32 equivalent) below ISO 64 or to 约 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1 or 2 EV (ISO 102400 equivalent) above ISO 25600; auto ISO sensitivity control available

rows.label: 动态D-Lighting
rows.value: Can be selected from auto, extra high, high, normal, low or off

rows.originalValue: 约 1005 g/2 lb 3.5 oz with battery and XQD memory card but without body cap; 约 915 g/2 lb 0.3 oz (camera body only)
